content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.E./M.Tech./MCA/M.Sc. (Computer Science/Information Technology/Data Science/Artificial Intelligence or relevant discipline) Other conditions: No TA/DA is permissible for appearing in the interview. Selected candidate may be encouraged to enroll for PhD at NIT Raipur. Desirable: Knowledge of basic programming skills in Web development, Flutter, Python/C, C++.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial appointment will be for 3 months. Continuation is subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds. Appointment is co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Offline interview Shortlisted candidates will be called for an offline interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 15 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.E./M.Tech./MCA/M.Sc. in Computer Science/Information Technology/Data Science/Artificial Intelligence or relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA is permissible for appearing in the interview. Selected candidate may be encouraged to enroll for PhD at NIT Raipur.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Offline interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an offline interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial appointment will be for 3 months. Continuation is subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds. Appointment is co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Raipur.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duly filled application form; Scanned documents pertaining to educational qualifications; Age proof.
